notes.title: New challenges in version 25.32.0!
notes.content: [h1]New challenges in version 25.32.0![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It’s been a while since the last release, but I can finally share with you all the new features I’ve been passionately working on.[/p][p]The game has now taken its desired shape, so from this point on I will focus primarily on optimization, bug fixes, and adding engaging details.[/p][p][/p][h2]Main Changes[/h2][p]Over the past months, patch after patch, I’ve completely overhauled the interfaces to make the experience more modern and enjoyable. Here’s what you’ll find in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Main menu[/b] redesigned with an optimized layout;[/p][/*][*][p]Updated icons for the [b]game modes[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options menu[/b] with more colorful accents;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox menu interface[/b] refined (visible when at least one Level Set from the Steam Workshop is active);[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the [b]Sandbox mode UI[/b] for smoother navigation;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player timer[/b] moved to the top center for instant glanceability;[/p][/*][*][p]New icons in [b]dialogs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes are complemented by minor graphical and functional tweaks designed to significantly enhance usability.[/p][list][*][p][b]Expanded language support[/b]: introduced a dedicated font for Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, and Japanese;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrun Mode[/b]: time is now measured only in minutes and seconds (goodbye to unnecessary hours!);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox[/b]: interface revamp to simplify operations, with new keyboard shortcuts. Be sure to check out the in-game guide.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]But that’s not all…[/h2][p]It’s time to unveil the [b]new additions[/b] that will make your experience even richer![/p][p][/p][h2]New Game Additions[/h2][h3]Barrier (solid)[/h3][p]Different from the standard barrier, this block remains hidden until the Player approaches, guaranteeing a surprise effect.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/7aae0373aa9766fab47bb372f44665640abad483.png"][/img] [/p][h3]A New Story[/h3][p]Level sharing, Speedrun competitions, and player interaction: these are the elements I consider fundamental. That’s why I’m excited to introduce the mode I’m most proud of to date.[/p][p][/p][h2]Playroom: the Game Room[/h2][p]Up to four players can compete in four different [b]minigames[/b], each more fun than the last:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bulb Rush[/b]: touch the bulbs to color them; whoever lights up the most within the time limit wins;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vertical Run[/b]: a vertical race; whoever reaches the portal first triumphs;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hide'n'Seek[/b]: reduced visibility and a secret seeker; if the seeker finds everyone, they win; otherwise, the hiders win;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maze Escape[/b]: invisible maze with unique paths for each player; the fastest one claims victory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Available Now![/h2][p]All these new features are [b]already integrated[/b] into the game. Don’t wait: download or update it, and let me know what you think of the evolution of [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b]![/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0![/h1]

Hello everyone!

In the month following the game's release, I've had time to reflect and experiment with [b]new ideas[/b] that I'm finally ready to share with you.

[h2]Main changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped several interfaces[/b]: the game mode menu now features more appealing button designs; the Sandbox menu has been completely redesigned, with a new system for displaying level sets; some elements of the Sandbox interface have also been refined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/2467508facdfaed1aa3bd4031e963058193301af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/825e0430b4085443bd0beb5cd6dcebcd423cd7b5.png[/img]
[*][b]Added sound effects[/b] for Temporary Blocks and Propulsor Blocks.
[*]The button for Hardcore mode will no longer appear at the end of the Echo level, but only after completing the entire Story Mode.
[/list]
[h2]But that’s not all...[/h2]
It’s time to talk about the [b]new additions[/b]!

[h2]New in-game additions[/h2]
[h3]New [b]blocks[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Bulb[/b]: a block that can emit light... or darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/a31f01ef80a42da9a95e802795dacff08853a5db.png[/img]
[*][b]Block (key)[/b]: can only be removed using a key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/92a663e3b6e39355a4bd7f4a2e4c4eb05c064987.png[/img][/list]
[h3][b]Key[/b][/h3]
Once you approach a key, it will start to follow you until it finds a Key Block to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/0c246626b39ad37d44191b83082b851e8d569625.png[/img]
[h3][b]Dead Singularity[/b][/h3]
The Dead Singularity is what remains of a collapsed Singularity: it expands endlessly, [b]destroying everything in its path[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/3e89bf7db71600941e5a94ccb3fdb37553c84674.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hourglass[/b][/h3]
The Hourglass is born from the collision of two Prisms, which fused to generate an object capable of enabling passage between different dimensions of light... but only for a [b]limited time[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/5ad467740a252d16a2125ffe2225f58319e79d0b.png[/img]
[h2]A new tale[/h2]
The new content arrives with [b]two new game modes[/b]: [b]Escape[/b] and [b]Permadeath[/b], two sides of the same nightmare.

In the first, you must escape from a crumbling realm determined to hold you back by any means. In the second, you’ll face an extreme challenge where [b]every mistake has real and permanent consequences[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/8ea7b34b70766d55811f4a1fdb748171f9c0d4f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/df8810327bde5f287c305a38669d95c204e136f2.png[/img]
[h2]Minor changes and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the number of charges of an Orb in the Veritas level: from 3 to 5.
[*]Slightly reduced block collision to minimize the “floating player” effect.
[*]Also reduced the collisions of Singularities.
[*]Fixed some translations that weren’t displaying correctly.
[*]Propulsor Blocks now stop slightly farther from platforms, preventing the risk of getting stuck.
[*]Fixed several bugs.
[*]Changed the system for indicating game versions; from now on it will be [i]year.week.version[/i].
[/list]
[h2]Available now![/h2]
All these features are [b]already integrated[/b] into the game. Don’t waste time: download or update it, and let me know what you think about the evolution of [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b]!

See you soon!

notes.title: Big News Coming to PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark!
notes.content:
[h1]Big News Coming to [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b]![/h1]

Hello everyone!

It's been a few months since the last update, and there's a good reason for that: I've been pouring all my energy into developing this game.

We're at a pivotal moment, and the incredible support received during last October's [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] has motivated me more than ever. I can't thank you enough, players, for the trust you've placed in this project and the amazing connections we've built.

[h2]A Game Reimagined from Scratch![/h2]
Taking into account your invaluable feedback and some new ideas, the game has undergone significant changes and additions. Let’s dive into the updates together!

[h2]Main Changes[/h2]
[list][*]"[i]Did you... did you say something?[/i]": NPCs and the player can now have conversations! This feature has allowed me to greatly expand on the game's original story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/74282787bd0c0166d0782477cf3f0f0d557d9857.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/5ec5f49e6dbeee62343ba842fa204d94993cce41.png[/img]
[*][b]A New Way to Travel Between Levels[/b]: The door has been replaced with a mystical portal, better fitting the game's atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/b9006199bdc3390d57efce037f2c6afa6c5edf9f.png[/img]
[*][b]Updated Textures[/b]: Basic blocks, shards, and some icons have a new look, enhancing the overall aesthetic.
[*][b]Input Improvements[/b]: Added controller and mouse/keyboard glyphs for a more intuitive gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/ca98720d17a24d47e2fce532151357dcfa7802c8.png[/img]
[*][b]Revamped Interface[/b]: A redesigned UI makes it more visually appealing and user-friendly.
[*][b]Level Optimization[/b]: The structure and level sets have been completely revamped to improve game performance and scalability.
[*][b]Structural Changes[/b]: Technical refinements for a better gameplay experience.[/list]
[h2]And the Best is Yet to Come...[/h2]
Let’s move on to the new implementations!

[h2]Game Additions[/h2]
[h3]New [b]Blocks[/b][/h3]
These new blocks join the existing ones, introducing new mechanics and puzzle types.
[list][*][b]Jump Block[/b]: Changes its state from solid to non-solid depending on the player's jump.
[*][b]Shard Block[/b]: Becomes solid by collecting hidden shards in the level set. This adds another layer of complexity to the game: a temporal one, complementing the spatial challenges.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/06d8855a888910d912d7f7e7427842072b289c54.png[/img]
[h3][b]Checkpoints[/b][/h3]
One of the most requested features! Checkpoints serve as respawn points in case of death and reset timers, giving players more time to complete levels. [b]Shards collected[/b] are temporarily saved upon activation, but to fully claim them, you still need to complete the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/6dcd8b70c376599345420fd2060d01a63bfe5556.png[/img]
[h3]New [b]Power-Up: The Spring![/b][/h3]
This new mechanic lets you jump mid-air, even repeatedly, depending on the charges provided by the power-up, allowing you to reach otherwise impossible distances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/dd631d9f8b911308b7cf24d28f05fbaf962f44d9.png[/img]
[h3]New [b]Areas[/b]![/h3]
The newly introduced areas come with unique mechanics to enrich the gameplay experience. They activate when the player enters or exits them. Here are the different types of areas:
[list][*][b]Info[/b]: Displays a customizable panel with an image and text upon activation (in Sandbox mode). In Story mode, they're used for instructions on controls and navigating PHOTOBIA's dark world. [spoiler]And more.[/spoiler]
[*][b]Timer[/b]: Sets a time limit to complete the current level, increasing challenge and tension.
[*][b]Color[/b]: Changes the light dimension the player is in, creating dimensional pockets and making the environment more dynamic.
[*][b]Light[/b]: Enables or disables the light emitted by the character.[/list]
These areas add depth and vibrancy to the game world, turning each level into an even more engaging puzzle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/2d95a5d76fe376eaf5879176fb68219e9f480326.png[/img]
[h2]A New Tale, an [b]Improved Story Mode[/b][/h2]
The listed features are integrated into a completely renewed story mode, with updated levels designed to make the most of the new mechanics.

[h2]Available Now![/h2]
All these additions are already present in the [b]demo[/b], with save progress, [b]including collected shards[/b], carrying over to the full version of the game. So don’t wait: download or update the demo, and let me know your thoughts on how [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b] is shaping up!

Thanks again for your incredible support.

See you soon!

notes.title: PHOTOBIA: Big news coming and participation in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]PHOTOBIA: Big news coming and participation in Steam Next Fest![/h1]

Hello everyone!

I’m thrilled to bring you the latest updates on PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark. Over the past months, I’ve been working tirelessly to improve every aspect of the game, and I can’t wait to share the results with you!

[h2]Optimizations and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] I’ve spent a lot of time hunting down and eliminating a multitude of bugs. The game’s stability has significantly improved!
[*][b]Level Restructuring:[/b] I’ve completely revamped how levels and level sets are structured. This has led to significant optimizations, both in terms of performance and space usage. Additionally, I’ve added more detail to the story levels and modified others to make them more intuitive, especially based on the feedback I gathered from letting more people test the game. A huge thanks to everyone who provided feedback!
[*][b]Revamped Interfaces:[/b] The user interface has undergone a complete rework, both in the various menus and in sandbox mode. As for the latter, the experience is now more intuitive and enjoyable!
[/list]
[h2]A Sneak Peek at the New Features[/h2]

Here are some images showcasing the recent improvements:

[h3]The "before" of the sandbox interface.[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/85b8d32d1fb7e2d289aafe53d04bb02ebb46749b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/70e7de6b3be63faaa781fe3f4be5778d951ec936.png[/img]

[h3]The "after" of the sandbox interface - more intuitive and pleasant to use.[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/c2d657dac975e7cb45c6ec39510b382d52e0bf6e.png[/img]

[h3]The new mode menu - clean, sleek, and attractive.[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/065c63d336e8e71026a394cfea80d740a9717d2b.png[/img]

[h2]PHOTOBIA at Steam Next Fest[/h2]

As the last piece of news (but certainly not least!), I’m excited to announce that PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark will be featured at the [b]Steam Next Fest from October 14 to 21[/b]!

During the event, you’ll be able to try out the demo, experience the latest improvements to the [b]levels[/b], and [b]share your feedback[/b], which is crucial in making the game even better!

[h2]Join the Community and Stay Updated![/h2]

Add PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b] to stay on top of the most important news! And if you want to be an active part of development, report bugs, propose new features, or simply chat with other fans, [b]join our Discord server[/b]! You’ll find the link at the bottom of this article. Together, we can make PHOTOBIA even more extraordinary!

I can’t wait to see your reactions and hear your feedback. Your passion and support are what drive me to give my best every day.

Get ready to dive into the darkness of PHOTOBIA like never before.

See you soon!

notes.title: Embrace the Fun: Controller Support in Development!
notes.content:
[h1]Controller Support: An Important Step in Development![/h1]

Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share an update on our development: I’m working on [b]controller support[/b]! Soon, you’ll be able to dive into the game using your favorite controller, and I can’t wait for you to try it out.
[list]
[*][b]Steam Controller[/b]
[*][b]DualShock 4[/b]
[*][b]Xbox One Controller[/b]
[/list]
I’ve already started testing these options, and I’m really pleased with how they’re performing in Story and Hardcore modes. My goal is to make the game more accessible and enjoyable for those who prefer using a controller over mouse and keyboard.

That said, I want to be clear: creating levels in sandbox mode and navigating menus will continue to be available only with mouse and keyboard for the time being. I’ve focused first on what matters most: delivering an engaging gameplay experience in the main modes, and I believe we’re on the right track!

I’m really excited to hear what you think and can’t wait to share the next steps with you!

Stay tuned for more updates, and if you haven’t already, add PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark to your Steam wishlist to keep up with the latest news.

See you soon!
